name: The Flow Country
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: The Flow Country is a vast, wind-swept expanse of blanket bog across Caithness and Sutherland in the far north of Scotland. It is Europe's largest peatland, covering roughly 4,000 square kilometres of deep peat scattered with shimmering bog pools. The peat has been building for about 9,000 years, locking away huge amounts of carbon, and the open moorland shelters a distinctive mix of wading birds.
